name: Kolkata Oceanic
_hf: Kolkata Radio HF: 10066 kHz, 6556 kHz (MWARA SEA-1). From MWARA listings; confirm with India vACC / current India AIP ENR 2.1. On VATSIM pilots use the VHF alias in "frequency".
